en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a hilly vineyard landscape with scattered houses and villas. On the ridge to the left stands a round commemorative tower labeled "Bismarckturm." Farther right on the hilltop is a prominent building labeled "Spitzhaus." At the top right of the image, the settlement name "Oberlößnitz." is printed in red Gothic-style script. The scene is pastoral, with terraced slopes, orchards, and early 20th‑century buildings.
